name: lofi
description: A lofi soundtrack that follows the session: calm while Claude is idle, focus while it works, flow during heavy editing, a chime when tests pass and a low note when they fail. Off until /lofi on. Original music, synthesised for this mod. Needs function hooks (early access).

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: 0 to 100. /lofi vol changes it for good.

idleMinutes.title: Minutes of calm after a turn
idleMinutes.description: How long the calm loop plays after Claude finishes before the music stops.
